purpose: Published-voltage comparisons, declared native load-law envelopes, and numerical consistency are separate evidence categories.
tolerance_basis: Propagate the existing 0.003 pu published-voltage allowance through the declared load law before comparison. Retain the original 0.05 kW/kvar numeric and balance allowances and 0.1 A current floor. Do not fit tolerances to the new output residuals.
scope: No native load parameters or voltage limits are changed. The envelope is an analytical prediction conditioned on published voltage and declared native Model=1 behavior, not independent measured P/Q or current data. Numerical balance is internal consistency, not field validation. No restoration/protection validation is implied.
